responsibility: Implements Rust backend lowering for inline assembly expressions into GCC ASM_EXPR trees. It converts Rust HIR InlineAsm and LlvmInlineAsm nodes into the GCC tree representation by assembling the template string, compiling input and output operand expressions through the normal expression compiler, packaging constraint strings and operands into TREE_LIST chains, setting ASM flags such as basic/inline/volatile, and building clobber metadata where available, making this file the backend bridge from Rust inline-assembly HIR to GCC’s generic asm statement form.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation of the asm-lowering API declared in rust-compile-asm.h: it contains the executable code that builds GCC ASM_EXPR nodes for both Rust InlineAsm and LLVM-style inline asm, including operand/tree-list construction and asm flag setup.
